info.name: CF1-CancellationSettleNow
info.description: Road (a): card ride, fee charged at cancel via Stripe. Self-contained and API-only (no DB/Redis access): a fresh random driver + rider per run; ConfigPilot rollouts (snapshotted first, restored last) seed the cancellation-dues JL (fee 5.00 + tax 1.20 + 15% commission), RiderConfig (enablePaymentRefunds = true, settleCancellationFeeBeforeNextRide = true) and TransporterConfig invoiceConfig.commissionAggregationEnabled. Builds the cancelled ride, then asserts the forward money through APIs: rider booking (CANCELLED, paymentStatus Completed), fareBreakup cap 6.20 (5.00 + 1.20), RideCancellation invoice + PDF, dues cleared (dashboard), driver wallet ledger (fee credit 5.00 + 1.20, CancellationCommission 0.741 + 0.189 debit) and the forward Commission invoice. Proves the enablePaymentRefunds kill-switch with an OFF rollout (400) and back ON, then two cap/2 driver-deducted refunds: refund-request list/info, per-refund wallet legs (driver share debit + commission rebate), nets-to-zero (clawed == booked, booking nets to 0), cap-exhaustion + admin-initiate rejection, rider and BPP refund invoices + PDFs, the negative Commission invoice, and the AggregatedCommission job netting the clawback to zero + its PDF.
